answer: A proof-of-burn mechanism deters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to permanently destroy base currency to mint an identity credential. An adversary incurs the verifiable, unrecoverable capital cost of burned tokens per identity. Whether validating micro-contracts for a citrus grove or relaying sensor feeds from a calm zephyr to a coastal gale, each key requires a burn proof. However, this permanently destroys capital and imposes high entry barriers on lightweight agents.
